turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Thanks for the note. Answers below, and I've cc'd [PERSON_3] since he owns the telephony side of this.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: QM rollout. Still behind plan. We had the Hartford supervisors trained in September, but the scorecard calibration is taking longer than we thought. The Medicare team is scoring calls now, P&C is not live yet. I'd rather not put a date on it until [PERSON_3] and I sit down with the supervisors again.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: PreSense. Mostly fine, but there's one thing that's been nagging at us. [PERSON_3] pulled 40 transferred calls from last week and 9 of them reached the second agency with the PreSense details missing. So the caller gets transferred and the agent on the other end has nothing on the screen, no ad, no pages, nothing. That's about one in four on the transfer path, which is higher than we'd like given how much of our Medicare volume ends up transferring. [PERSON_3] can send you the call IDs.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Seasonal headcount. This is the one that's actually keeping me up at night. We bring on a large group of licensed agents for the Medicare Advantage open enrollment window, roughly 45 people, and they're with us from October through December, then most of them roll off. Paying the full QM seat price for seasonal staff we only have from October to December is very hard for us to justify. I'd like to understand what options exist on that, because at the current per-seat number we're looking at a real budget problem for next year, and it's the kind of thing that gets flagged when we build the 2027 plan.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: On the rest, no complaints. Genesys and Salesforce are doing what they should, Google Ads conversions are landing.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Let me know what you need from us.
